description: Project Resolution Method, from RULES.md. Project Sizes and their Workload; the Work Die per relevant Skill Tier; the Skill Level bonus added to every Work Die (Level - 1, up to +9); the d20 Project Event ladder and each event's description. effectOptions are the examples each description lists, offered as quick picks for the event's effect.

events.name: Catastrophe
events.description: Something seriously goes wrong. This may cause major Progress loss, injuries, destroyed equipment, wasted resources, structural damage, or another severe complication.

events.name: Setback
events.description: A problem slows the Project. This may cause some Progress loss, wasted resources, damaged tools, minor injuries, or reduced efficiency.

events.name: Nothing Unusual
events.description: The day's work proceeds as expected. No additional effects occur.

events.name: Boon
events.description: Something goes particularly well. This may grant bonus Progress, conserve resources, improve efficiency, preserve tools, or provide another useful advantage.

events.name: Breakthrough
events.description: Something exceptional occurs. This may result in a large Progress gain, improved Project quality, a new Theory, Skill growth, discovering a superior method, or another major benefit.
